subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should maintainers accept pre-fix production logs plus positive/negative predicate tests as proof for this non-inducible xAI/Grok provider-rotation error, or require organic after-fix logs before merge?
rationale: The code path is source-reproducible and narrow, but the external-PR proof gate normally requires after-fix real behavior proof that the contributor says cannot be generated on demand.

options.title: Accept proof override
options.body: Apply a proof override and merge after exact-head checks if maintainers agree the provider-side trigger makes after-fix proof impractical.

options.title: Wait for organic proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a future xAI rotation produces redacted after-fix gateway logs showing the retry succeeds.

options.title: Close and refactor later
options.body: Decline this narrow fix and track a broader provider-error classification/retry design separately.
